summary: Iteration 8 SECURITY tests. Backend 7/7 PASS: security headers present with exact values (nosniff, DENY, strict-origin-when-cross-origin, camera=(), HSTS max-age=31536000, CORP same-site, X-XSS 1;mode=block, X-Robots noindex, Cache-Control includes no-store); rate limits verified via localhost:8001 — login 11th=429, signup 6th=429, forgot 6th=429, track 21st=429 with body {'detail':'Too many requests. Please slow down and try again in a moment.'}; regression admin login works, guest COD checkout creates order. Frontend anti-theft: storefront contextmenu blocked (defaultPrevented=true), body user-select=none, image dragstart blocked, copy on body blocked, copy INSIDE <input> ALLOWED, Ctrl+S and Ctrl+U blocked. On /receipt/* Ctrl+P is NOT blocked (defaultPrevented=false). Admin panel opts out: body.dataset.admin='1', contextmenu NOT prevented, user-select=auto. Regression FIX VERIFIED: Settings→Branding save shows only 'Site settings updated' success toast (no false 'Save failed'); PUT /api/admin/settings/site returns 200; theme reset to emerald.
critical_code_review_comments: Cache-Control header from backend is 'no-store' but public URL shows 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' (proxy/CF appending directives). Functionally stronger, not a bug — noted for reviewer awareness.
server.py is 1417 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth.py, orders.py, admin.py, settings.py) for maintainability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 12 anti-theft + admin opt-out + Settings save regression checks passed
